- 10. Security: We use reasonable technical and organizational measures designed to protect uploaded files, generated outputs, logs, and other information from unauthorized access, misuse, loss, or disclosure.
- 11. Children’s Privacy: Media Manipulator is not intended for children under the age of 13, or the minimum age required by applicable law in the user’s jurisdiction.
- 12. International Users: Media Manipulator may be operated from the United States or other locations. If you access the website from outside the United States, your information may be processed in countries that may have different data protection laws than your country of residence.

- 14. Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control: Media Manipulator honours Global Privacy Control (GPC). If your browser or an extension sends a GPC signal, we automatically treat it as an opt-out of any sale or sharing of your personal information for advertising purposes, we apply it on every visit — including overriding an advertising opt-in you may have given previously — and we record that we did so.
- 15. Changes to This Privacy Policy: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we make changes, we will update the “Last Updated” date at the top of this page.
- 16. Contact Us: The contact form at media-manipulator.com/contact reaches the same people as the address below; Section 1.11 explains what it collects and how long messages are kept.
- 17. The Media Manipulator App: This section applies to the Media Manipulator app for Android, operated by CreaTV Ltd.
